title: AphaVoice: Text-to-Speech Model for Aphasia Patient Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While language therapy is the primary treatment for post-stroke aphasia, limited clinical resources often restrict patient access to proper care. Addressing this gap requires reliable training simulations for medical professionals. However, current AI efforts focus almost exclusively on speech processing, leaving speech generation largely unexplored. This study introduces AphaVoice, a novel text-to-speech (TTS) framework explicitly engineered to synthesize highly realistic aphasic speech. Evaluated against state-of-the-art TTS systems, AphaVoice demonstrates a superior ability to capture the clinical feature of dysfluency, outperforming existing models in temporal metrics while consistently maintaining speaker identity. By leveraging latent space shifting, the model also supports multi-speaker generation without sacrificing phonetic realism. translated_title: AphaVoice：用于失语症患者模拟的文语转换模型
translated_abstract: 虽然语言治疗是中风后失语症的主要治疗方法，但有限的临床资源常常限制患者获得适当的护理。要解决这一缺口，就需要为医疗专业人员提供可靠的培训模拟。然而，当前的AI研究几乎完全集中在语音处理上，语音生成在很大程度上仍未被探索。本研究提出了AphaVoice，这是一个专门用于合成高度逼真失语症语音的新型文语转换（TTS）框架。与最先进的TTS系统相比，AphaVoice在捕捉非流畅性这一临床特征方面展现出卓越能力，在时间指标上优于现有模型，同时始终保持说话者身份的一致性。通过利用潜在空间偏移技术，该模型还支持多说话人生成，且不牺牲语音的真实性。最终，AphaVoice为医疗培训和临床实践提供了一个可扩展、高保真的工具。
tldr: AphaVoice是一个专门合成逼真失语症语音的文语转换模型，能够精准捕捉非流畅性这一临床特征，并通过潜在空间偏移支持多说话人生成，为医疗培训提供了可扩展、高保真的失语症模拟工具。
